blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Monday revealed that he and his team had identified flood control projects with “double appropriations” in the 2027 General Appropriations Bill (GAB). “We found items for flood control projects in the budget bill. Not only were these flood control projects, there were double appropriations for them,” Lacson said in a dzMM interview. These double appropriations are separate from the 30 supposed “ghost” multipurpose buildings that were repeatedly funded from 2024 to 2026 despite no progress in construction. “We flagged at least 30 such projects in various parts of the country,” he added.
